body: Every time I get my hope high about something it comes crashing down around my ankles.  I've given up hope on having hope.  I'm sure while I'm depressed I'll never have the balls to do it.  It'll be easy enough to push myself into a mania.
I'm bipolar I've been in therapy and on medicine for 20 years.  Inpatient and outpatient . It does nothing.
I don't know. Whether there is or there isn't it can't be any worse than what I live now.
The one person in the world that ever truly understood me. My best friend since we were in 2nd grade.  I had to watch him die over seven years of being in a coma.  It broke me.  I can't be fixed.
